newsitem.title: CROATIA: Zagrebacka Banka rises on Croatia bourse.
newsitem.headline: Zagrebacka Banka rises on Croatia bourse.

text.p: The strong dollar pushed up the price of Zagrebacka Banka on Croatia's central bourse in Thursday's mid-morning trade, market participants said.
Zagrebacka hit 2,300 kuna by 0930 GMT, selling two packages of 60 and 10 shares each. It opened at 2,200 kuna after closing at 2,205 kuna on Wednesday.
"Zagrebacka rose nicely throughout the morning, its price did not falter at all," said Zoran Ilic of Consult Invest brokerage.
The bank's Global Depository Receipts (GDRs), trading in U.S. dollars in London, fetched $36.125, up from $34.875 at the open.
Zagrebacka's rise might also be due to speculations about its good half-year results, another trader said.
Ilic said the bank accounted for nine out of the total of 28 transactions made by mid-morning in Zagreb, selling some 2,000 shares.
"Bids are now at 2,290 kuna while ask prices fetched 2,350 kuna," Ilic said. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
